biography: Taiwanese researcher based in Bangkok. PhD researcher at Thammasat University's School of Global Studies and researcher with the China-Global South Project (CGSP), working on Chinese AI governance, Digital Silk Road infrastructure, and AI-enabled cognitive warfare in the Asia Pacific. Co-author of "Signals in the Noise" (SSRN preprint), proposing an OSINT-based framework for detecting behavioral signatures of AI loss of control. Previously an AI red-teaming and disinformation analyst at Accenture. Fluent in Mandarin, English, and Thai.
